findings.ac: Stress Cases: Corrupted/missing references/ files detected by setup/update
findings.text: AC names 'corrupted' as well as 'missing', but skill_problems() only tests ref.is_file() for cited references; an empty, truncated or garbage reference file passes. test_suite_detects_missing_reference_file only unlinks refs[0] of 4a-verify-and-ship, and no test writes a zero-byte or damaged reference, so the 'corrupted' half has no failing assertion.

findings.ac: Running /stratosphere-update refreshes skills from dist/skills/ and cleans legacy directories
findings.text: Legacy cleanup (dist/claude-code, dist/antigravity payload, commands/) is well tested through check_suite.py legacy. The 'refreshes skills from dist/skills/' half is only prose in update SKILL.md Phase 0.6 ('Phase 1's scaffolder places them'). No new test asserts the update flow refreshes skills from the bundle; test_update_flow.py is pre-existing and not changed by this slice.

findings.ac: /stratosphere-setup 15/22 halts; 22/22 passes and proceeds to scaffold
findings.text: The script tests cover exit codes, '15/22', the 7 missing names and the remediation literal. The SKILL wiring tests (test_setup_runs_suite_check_before_scaffolding..., test_update_runs_suite_and_legacy_checks...) only compare str.index positions. Nothing asserts the 'do not scaffold' halt text or that exit 0 continues to scaffold. The no-argument default (skills_dir = PLUGIN_ROOT.parent), which the SKILLs rely on ('no argument needed'), is never run: every suite test passes --skills-dir.

findings.ac: System-pack skills in .agents/skills but absent from Claude skills dir -> halts, lists, gives copy remediation
findings.text: test_claude_host_halts_when_system_pack_only_in_agents_skills asserts only that '.claude', 'skills', 'Copy-Item' and 'cp -r' appear in stdout. It does not check the source path (.agents/skills/<name>) or the destination (.claude/skills/<name>). Swapped or wrong cp arguments would still pass, and '.claude' can match any path text. The cp/Copy-Item arguments from cmd_visibility are unverified.

findings.ac: Stress Cases: references check (transitive/absolute citation forms)
findings.text: skill_problems() walks a transitive closure of cited references and REF_CITE has an absolute '.agents/skills/<x>/references/' branch. No test covers a reference that cites another missing reference, or the absolute form. A regression to a shallow check or a broken regex branch would pass every test in test_check_suite.py.

findings.ac: Docs/Constitution: skill locations stated once; workflows name skills only
findings.text: stratosphere-setup SKILL.md 'Template source' (line 41) still says Claude Code 'reads the same tree from .claude/skills/' and that in-project copies are live on every host. This contradicts the new constitution text and the visibility check (Claude Code does not read .agents/skills; scaffold.py SKILL_TARGETS excludes .claude/skills). The constitution test checks only substring presence, so the stale claim is unguarded.
